narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ten edges go round the top and ten round the bottom, which makes twenty edges.
<bookmark mark='upright'/>Look at the lines running from the top down to the bottom.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Those are edges too, and they were not counted.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 10 + 10 = 20 edges; the edges round the top and bottom glow; the upright edges stay dark and then flash; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Count the two ends first, then the side faces.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Edges come in three groups, top, bottom and joining.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A pencil is a prism with six sided ends. Count its faces, edges and vertices.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the lantern; two lines appear: count the ends, then the sides; edges come in three groups; then a pencil shaped prism with 6 sided ends and three empty boxes
